people.name: Ben-hadad
people.line: King of Aram, contemporary of Asa and Baasha.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

translations.web: “I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it will devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.”
translations.bsb: “I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-hadad.”
translations.kjv: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Benhadad.
